description: This Java file is a Spring MVC controller class for managing shipping methods in an admin panel of an e-commerce application. It handles displaying shipping methods, editing configurations, saving, and deleting shipping modules, and setting up menu navigation.

classes.name: ShippingMethodsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing shipping method configurations within the admin panel.

methods.name: displayShippingMethods
methods.description: Displays a list of available shipping methods and their configuration status.

methods.name: displayShippingMethod
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for a specific shipping method identified by code.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Processes and saves the configuration for a shipping method.

methods.name: saveCustomWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles saving configurations for custom weight-based shipping quotes.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Deletes a shipping method configuration identified by code.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu navigation context for the admin interface.
